2021_206_may_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for May 2021, carried on the Board of Education agenda for the July 20, 2021 meeting, itemizes every district PCARD transaction posted under the journal entry description "MAY PCARD EXP," listing transaction date and merchant, budget unit, account code, transaction amount, and credits. Charges run from 4/27/2021 through 5/25/2021 and are spread across general fund, grant, special education, adult education, community education/childcare, and student activity budget units. The listing closes with a subtotal of 213,788.27 in transaction amounts against 2,306.53 in credits and Total Expenses of 211,481.74. The printed report runs 24 pages, each footed with the date 7/15/2021.

2021_206_may_2021_pcard_report.verbose:
Troy School District's PCARD Report for May 2021 is a 24-page line-item register of district purchasing-card activity, placed before the Board of Education on the July 20, 2021 meeting agenda. Every page repeats the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD REPORT, MAY 2021" and the column headings Transaction Description, JE Number, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, Credits, and every page footer pairs the page number with the print date 7/15/2021. All rows share a single journal entry description, "MAY PCARD EXP." Individual transaction dates run from 4/27/2021 through 5/25/2021, so the register captures late-April purchases posting into the May cycle as well as May activity.

Stated totals. The register ends with a Subtotal line of 213,788.27 in the Transaction Amount column and 2,306.53 in the Credits column, followed by Total Expenses of 211,481.74.

Largest charges. The single largest line is PAYPAL *OUTD on 4/30/2021 for 8,928.00, charged to budget unit 101052112005200, account code 5110. Next is PIONEER VALL on 5/12/2021 for 5,940.00 (120007111698810, 5110) and NASSP PRODUC on 5/6/2021 for 5,767.25 (700070399710000, 5000). SP * GLOWFOR on 5/25/2021 posted 4,990.00 to 101070127012700 under equipment code 6410. SSI SCHOOL S charged 3,714.72 on 5/11/2021 and 1,857.36 on 5/20/2021, both to 101013111100100. STAPLS732968 posted 3,007.72 on 4/30/2021 to 101016111100100, alongside a companion 87.06 charge. LEARNKEY IN billed 2,995.00 on 5/14/2021 to adult education unit 529202391660000. EXPLORELEARN charged 2,966.00 on 5/3/2021 and THE READING 2,919.99 on 5/14/2021, both to grant units in the 120007 series. SQ *MARTIN L appears twice at 2,500.00 each, on 4/29/2021 and 5/11/2021, against 101009111100100. PETRUZELLOS charged 2,400.00 on 5/12/2021 to 700070399732100; WAVE - *WOOT 2,321.77 on 5/6/2021 to 101070113351000; APPLE.COM/US 2,199.00 on 5/3/2021 to 101070127031200 under 5990; SCHOLASTIC 2,085.50 on 5/18/2021 to 120007111601400. Other four-figure entries include ULINE *SHIP 1,710.50 (4/29/2021) and 1,374.00 (5/19/2021) to 101904261870000, AMZN MKTP US 1,539.99 (5/5/2021) to 531004118620000, STAPLS733018 1,441.48 (5/7/2021) to 101011111100100, AMAZON.COM*6 1,400.00 (5/3/2021) to 700070399718000, CASAS 1,345.00 (5/18/2021) to 120210227646000 under 3450, AMZN MKTP US 1,248.24 (5/19/2021) to 120007119601400, FLINN SCIENT 1,240.41 (5/4/2021) to 101070113340100, AMZN MKTP US 1,178.83 (5/10/2021) to 101074113007400, CAROLINA BIO 1,168.16 (4/28/2021) to 101070113340100, MODERN BIOLO 1,149.99 (5/13/2021) to 101071113340100, IN *NOAH'S A 1,149.00 (5/7/2021) to 530212351021200, STAPLS732986 1,095.94 (5/3/2021) to 101050241031000, STAPLS733110 1,094.99 (5/21/2021) to 700070399703800, IN *MIDLAND 1,050.00 (4/27/2021) to 700071399909700, AMZN MKTP US 1,044.65 (5/10/2021) to 101015111100100, WWW.DONORSCH 1,000.00 (5/5/2021) to 700050299667300, and APPLE.COM/US 1,000.00 (5/7/2021) to 101790225000000 under 3450.

Budget units beginning with 101 (general fund) account for most rows, with school-level units such as 101005111100100, 101007111100100, 101008111100100, 101009111100100, 101010111100100, 101011111100100, 101012111100100, 101013111100100, 101014111100100, 101015111100100, 101016111100100 and 101017111100100 each carrying long runs of supply purchases.
